content: Da̱wuda wawa ta̱ lyuci va Kayila
Ana a dammai Da̱wuda, <<A̱yi ɗa nda aza a Filistiya a ta yuwusan uvon na aza a Kayila a̱tsuma̱ e iɗa ya Yahuda, waru a̱ ta̱ purusa̱ le ishina o osoroto,>>
a̱vu Da̱wuda pati ya̱ A̱sulazuva, u damma, <<N 'ya̱wa̱ n riya̱a̱ aza a Filistiya nu uvon?>> A̱vu A̱sulazuva a damma yi, <<'Ya̱wa̱ vu riya̱a̱ le tsura̱ vu wawa aza a Kayila.>>
Amma a̱vu ama a̱ Da̱wuda a damma yi, <<Ka̱lyuwa̱, a̱yi ɗa nda pa a̱tsuma̱ a Yahuda tsu ta uwwusa wovon. Cine tsa ɗa wo o'wo na̱ tsu 'ya̱wa̱ Kayila tsu riya̱a̱ aza a Filistiya nu uvon?>>
A̱vu Da̱wuda da̱shi pati ya̱ A̱sulazuva, a̱vu A̱sulazuva a̱ usu yi, <<Lapa a̱ cipa̱ Kayila, adama a na n ta ca aza a Filistiya e ekere a̱ wu.>>
Ɗaɗa Da̱wuda na̱ ama a̱ yi a̱ ka̱ra̱i a̱ tyo Kayila, a̱vu a yuwan uvon na aza a Filistiya, waru o una le ta̱ na̱ a̱bunda̱ wa'a shi. A̱vu a̱ pura̱ iliyamunga i le. Reve u wawa ama a Kayila.
Waru a mantsa ma na Abiyata ulobo wa Ahimele sumai a̱ tyo ya̱ Da̱wuda'a ɗe Kayila, u ta̱wa̱ ta̱ na̱ epo o ukere wa̱ yi.

A damma ta̱ Shawulu a na Da̱wuda ta̱ ɗe Kayila, a̱vu Shawulu damma, <<A̱sula̱ a ta ca yi e ekere a̱ va̱, adama a na u ɓa̱ru ta̱ aciya̱yi, a na wo'woi uwa ta̱ a̱ lyuci na ri na̱ na̱ntsu na a̱ɓa̱ru yi na̱ aɗanga e rumu.>>
A̱vu Shawulu ɗe a̱soja a̱ yi suru a lapa a̱ cipa̱ a̱ tyo Kayila, adama a̱ ka̱nda̱ruwa̱ Da̱wuda na̱ ama a̱ yi nu uvon.
Ana Da̱wuda uwwai Shawulu ta yuwusan ifoɓi i na wa̱ ta̱wa̱ yi nu uvon, a̱vu u damma Abiyata ganu, <<Ta̱wa̱ na̱ epo.>>
Reve Da̱wuda yuwan avasa u damma, <<A̱sulazuva A̱sula̱ a Isra'ila, aagbashi a̱ wu a uwwa ta̱ a na na amayun Shawulu ta zama u ta̱wa̱ Kayila, tsa̱ra̱ u kototo lyuci adama a̱ va̱.

Amma Shawulu ta̱ zura̱ a̱ tyo Kayila cine aagbashi a̱ wu uwwai? Waru azagbain a Kayila a ta reme mu reve a ca mu ekere a̱yi? A̱sulazuva A̱sula̱ a Isra'ila, n te e ipati ya̱ wu vu damma aagbashi a̱ wu.>> Reve A̱sulazuva a damma, <<U ta̱ ta̱wa̱.>>
Reve Da̱wuda yuwisan yeci, <<Azagbain a Kayila a ta ca mu na̱ ama a̱ va̱ a̱ tyo e ekere a Shawulu?>> A̱vu A̱sulazuva a̱ usu, <<A ta ca ɗu.>>

Ɗaɗa Da̱wuda na̱ ama a̱ yi ele ama ukpakuta̱li (600), a̱ 'yon yi a lyawai Kayila, a̱vu a̱ ka̱ra̱ a̱ tyo uba̱ta̱ u na aa gura 'ya̱wa̱ suru adama e reme le wan. Ana a dammai Shawulu Da̱wuda suma ta̱ diga Kayila, a̱vu u bula̱ mmalu a̱ 'ya̱wa̱ ɗe.
A̱vu Da̱wuda isawan pe uba̱ta̱ o upa'atan a̱tsumona, ne e iɗa ya agaɗi wa̱ A̱tsumona a Zif. Waru Shawulu zamishi yi ta̱ urana suru, amma A̱sula̱ a ca Da̱wuda e ekere a̱ yi shi.
Shawulu 'ya̱wa̱ ta̱ izami ya̱ Da̱wuda
Ana Da̱wuda da̱na̱i Horesh a̱tsuma̱ A̱tsumona a Zif, reve wu uwwa Shawulu ta̱wa̱ ta̱ uba̱ta̱'a̱ izami ya̱ yi adama wu una yi.
Reve Jonata ulobo wa Shawulu u 'ya̱wa̱ uba̱ta̱ wa̱ Da̱wuda ɗe Horesh, a̱vu u ca yi adanshi wi isawan no okolo a̱ yi uba̱ta̱ wa̱ a̱ A̱sula̱ ulobonu.

A̱vu u damma yi, <<She vu uwwa wovon wan, ukere wa dada va̱ Shawulu wa̱a̱ ju'wa̱n wu shi. Vu to o'wo mogono a aci a aza a Isra'ila suru a̱mu gba n to o'wo dodu va̱ wu. Ko Shawulu dada va̱ reve ta̱ ne.>>
A̱vu ele ra a yuwan nzuwulai a̱ ma̱ka̱ka̱n ma̱ A̱sulazuva.
Reve Jonata ka̱mba̱ o u'wa, a̱vu Da̱wuda isawan pe Horesh.
Ɗaɗa aza a Zif a̱ 'ya̱wa̱i uba̱ta̱ wa Shawulu ɗe Gibiya a̱vu a damma, <<Da̱wuda ta̱ pe a̱tsuma̱ a̱ tsu uba̱ta̱ o upa'atan ɗe Horesh zuva va aagaɗi a Hakila upasu wu uyagi wa Jeshimon.
Gogo, mogono, she vu ta̱wa̱ mantsa ma na u lobono nuwu vu yuwan ne, waru tsu ta tara ume adama tsu ca yi e ekere a̱ wu.>>
Reve Shawulu damma, <<A̱sulazuva a zuwaa ɗu aba'un, adama a na i roco mu ta̱ isa'ani.
'Ya̱wa̱yi i yuwisan ifoɓi i ro. I gura reve uba̱ta̱ u na Da̱wuda tsu 'ya̱wusa̱ na za na ene niyi ɗe. Adama a na a damma mu ta̱ u tu nu ugbozu lon.
I gura reve ba̱ta̱ na waa pa'asan suru reve i ka̱mba̱ i damma mu urevu wa amayun. Reve tsu gereyi. Na̱ u ta̱ lo upasu'u, n ta̱ bunga̱ yi ko te ɗa u ri, a̱tsuma̱ o umatsun wa a aza a Yahuda suru.>>
A̱vu a̱ 'yon a̱ ka̱ra̱ a̱ tyo Zif babu Shawulu rawa. Da̱wuda gba na̱ ama a̱ yi a̱ da̱na̱ ta̱ A̱tsumona a̱ Mawon, upasu wu uyagi wa̱ Jeshimon a̱tsuma̱ o Uka̱ri wa Araba.

A̱vu Shawulu na ali o uvon a̱ yi a̱ 'ya̱wa̱ izami ya̱ yi, reve a damma Da̱wuda, ɗaɗa u ka̱ra̱i a̱ cipa̱ tyo a aatali a gbain o ro a̱vu wi isawan A̱tsumona a̱ Mawon. Ana Shawulu uwwai ne, a̱vu u lapa a̱ tyo a̱tsumona a̱ Mawon izami ya̱ yi.

Shawulu kuru ta̱ upasu u ta̱ wa a aatali a gbai'in Da̱wuda waru na ali o uvon a̱ yi o upasu we ire, a̱vu nan Da̱wuda a̱ jika̱ adama a la'a ya Shawulu. Ana Shawulu na ali o uvon a̱ yi a̱ da̱na̱i a rawusa zuzu na̱ le adama e reme le,
a̱vu malingata ma̱ ta̱wa̱ ya Shawulu u damma, <<Jika̱ vu ta̱wa̱, adama a na aza a Filistiya a̱ riya̱a̱ ta̱ iɗa i tsu nu uvon!>>
Ɗaɗa Shawulu lyawai izami ya̱ Da̱wuda a̱vu u 'ya̱wa̱ u riya̱a̱ aza a Filistiya nu uvon. Adama a ndolo a ɗa e ɗeyi uba̱ta̱'a̱ Aatali a Mala'a.
A̱vu Da̱wuda lapa a gawan diga lo, a̱vu u da̱nu uba̱ta̱ o upa'atan A̱tsumona a En Gedi.
